audience: equipment rental teams using HireHop to manage jobs and projects

useCases.title: Review jobs with late returns
useCases.text: Find rental jobs flagged for late returns, inspect a selected job and read its notes to prepare a follow-up list. Follow additional search pages for a complete report.

useCases.title: Inspect the jobs within a project
useCases.text: Find a project, review its details and list its jobs with their dates and statuses. Request subsequent pages when the project spans more than one page.

useCases.title: Browse rental products and depots
useCases.text: Review the rental product catalog, its categories and the depot list. The catalog shows products and does not calculate availability for a date range.
